//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the INPUT component — the text form field `.pa-input` (keen `PureAdmin.Components.Form.input/1`, svelte `forms/Input.svelte`). SCOPE = the BARE `<input class="pa-input ...">` both wrappers emit — a self-contained, mostly-flat control. There is NO `pa-input__*` element in the compiled CSS and NO base `pa-input--disabled` class: disabled/readonly/required are NATIVE boolean attrs on the control, not modifiers. The blessed empty shape (no value given) carries NO `value` attribute — matching snippets/forms.html (`<input type="text" class="pa-input">`); value is emitted only when supplied. Both wrappers default `type` to "text", so every golden carries `type="text"`. Sibling form controls (pa-select, pa-textarea) and the field-wrapper chrome around an input — `pa-form-group` / native `<label>` / `pa-form-help(--error)` — are DIFFERENT components / sub-slices, out of scope and prose-deferred below. keen's input/1 DOES emit a conditional `<.form_help variant="error">` AFTER the input, but only `:if={show_errors and has_errors?(errors)}`; no scenario feeds errors, so it never renders and both wrappers emit a bare input. See badge.json/button.json for the model; checkbox-list.json for the container/sub-slice deferral precedent.

propsVocabulary.size: xs|sm|lg|xl — height/padding/font size variant (default is the unmodified md input). Shared scale with pa-select/pa-textarea; this slice only exercises pa-input--{size}.
propsVocabulary.state: success|warning|error — standalone validation border (pa-input--{state}). Core defines these three for pa-input (and pa-select); pa-textarea has none.
propsVocabulary.themeColor: 1..9 theme colour slot — pa-input--color-N (paints the border with --pc-color-N). Orthogonal to state/size.
propsVocabulary.type: native input type (text|email|password|tel|url|search) — text-like inputs only. Structural: a native `type` attr, not a class. Both wrappers default to text.
propsVocabulary.value: native value attribute — emitted only when supplied (the blessed empty shape carries no value)
propsVocabulary.name: native name attribute
propsVocabulary.id: native id attribute (hand-set — the normalizer keeps real ids, only strips framework-generated ones)
propsVocabulary.disabled: native boolean attribute (there is NO pa-input--disabled class)
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough, not a core feature

goldenConventions: Goldens encode the bare `<input class="pa-input ...">` from snippets/forms.html plus the one convention both wrappers legitimately add: `type="text"` is always present (both default type to "text"). `value` appears ONLY in scenarios that set it — the empty shape omits it (svelte had to drop its `$bindable('')` default to stop emitting a phantom `value=""`; see the fix note). Native boolean attrs (disabled/readonly/required) are canonicalized to bare presence by the normalizer, so `disabled=""` (svelte) ≡ `disabled` (keen). Attribute order and class-token order are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability. themeColor scenarios omit state/size — pa-input--color-N composes but is the colour axis.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (the only `.pa-input*` selectors are the size/state/color modifiers below — no `pa-input__*` elements exist). `produces` is a class template; `produces: null` = a native HTML attribute (type/placeholder/value/name/id) or native boolean attr (disabled/readonly/required), NOT a pa-input modifier. capability.mjs expands each produces and cross-checks against main.css AND each wrapper map + the scenario set.

type.note: native `type` attribute — no class. Both wrappers default to text.

value.note: native value attribute — emitted only when supplied

disabled.note: native boolean attribute — there is NO pa-input--disabled class

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

deferred.//: No `pa-input__*` element classes exist in main.css, so there is nothing to bucket for the strict element-coverage check. This bucket records the field-wrapper chrome that is SEPARATE components (not the pa-input block) and intentionally out of this bare-control slice — prose only, no fixture ref. They carry no `pa-input` prefix so they don't affect the axis-1 element sweep; listed for reviewer orientation.
deferred.note-form-group: pa-form-group / pa-form-group--success|warning|error|horizontal|required — the field WRAPPER (form-layout component), not the input. Both wrappers model it separately; this slice is the control only.
deferred.note-form-help: pa-form-help / pa-form-help--error|success|warning|color-N — help/validation caption. keen input/1 emits pa-form-help--error only when :field errors are present (no scenario feeds errors); svelte Input has no help slot at all. Out of scope for the bare control.
deferred.note-label: native <label> inside .pa-form .pa-form-group is styled automatically (no pa-form-label class). Belongs to the form-group slice.

scenarios.name: basic
scenarios.note: The blessed default: a bare <input type="text" class="pa-input"> with NO value attribute. Proves neither wrapper emits a phantom value="" (svelte's $bindable default was dropped for this).

scenarios.name: value
scenarios.note: value is emitted only when supplied.

scenarios.name: type-text
scenarios.note: explicit type=text (same as the default) — exercises the enum option for coverage.

scenarios.name: disabled
scenarios.note: native disabled attr — no pa-input--disabled class. Normalizer canonicalizes to bare presence.

scenarios.name: name-id
scenarios.golden: <input type="text" name="username" id="username" placeholder="Enter username" class="pa-input">
scenarios.note: name + id are hand-set here; the normalizer keeps real (non-generated) ids.

scenarios.name: extra-class
scenarios.note: Class passthrough — the extra class is appended after pa-input.

scenarios.name: size-and-state
scenarios.note: size + state compose — class-token order is normalized away.

scenarios.name: combined
scenarios.golden: <input type="email" name="email" id="email" placeholder="you@co" required class="pa-input pa-input--sm pa-input--color-3">
scenarios.note: Stacks type + size + themeColor + native attrs to exercise class ordering + attribute passthrough together.
